#!/bin/sh
set -eu
root="$HOME/.local/share/ji-host"
operation="$root/operations/install-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT-ba0fabdfa990630d"
printf '%s\n' BACKUPS_BEFORE
if test -f "$operation/backups-before"; then cat "$operation/backups-before"; fi
printf '%s\n' CURRENT_BACKUPS
find "$root/data" -type f -name '*.pre-v*.backup' -print 2>/dev/null | LC_ALL=C sort
printf '%s\n' RESTORE_FILES
find "$root/data" -type f -name '*.restore' -print 2>/dev/null | LC_ALL=C sort
